_meta.what: Population PILOT — 12 of ~202 claims in VALIDATION.md. Not the corpus.
_meta.DECISION_1_storage: The spec never says WHERE populated fields live. Chosen: a SIDECAR keyed by claim id, not inline in VALIDATION.md. Reason: VALIDATION.md is append-only (established in the reconcile work), so editing historical entries to add fields would violate that; and machine-writable fields need a parseable format. JSON not YAML because no yaml module is installed. COST: the sidecar can drift from VALIDATION.md, which is a new instance of the failure this whole design targets, and nothing currently checks the link.
_meta.DECISION_2_restated_at: The spec says 'git log for the claim's location' without defining a claim's location. Chosen: NEWEST blame across the claim's line range. COST, and it is the known one: a typo fix on any line in the range advances restated-at and produces a false S1 candidate. This is exactly why RECONCILIATION.md §5 demoted S1 to SEMI-mechanical, and populating confirms the demotion was right. The alternative — blame of one designated line — was rejected because no session can identify that line reliably: a claim's assertion and its number are routinely on different lines, which is the 1,131 case itself.
_meta.DECISION_3_range: A claim's line range is set by hand at population time and stored. The spec does not define it. COST: hand-set and unverifiable; if VALIDATION.md is edited above the claim the stored range silently shifts. Line numbers are recorded WITH an anchor string so the range can be re-found.
_meta.DECISION_4_deductive_grounds: For grounds.kind=DEDUCTION there is no re-derivation command, so grounds-checked-at cannot be machine-written. Chosen: it equals the blame of the cited source lines. COST: it then can never be older than the artifact, so D4/S1 can never fire for a deductive claim — a silent exemption for a whole grounds kind, already flagged in PROVENANCE_FIELDS.md §8.5.

C01_1.5x.asserts: Functions flagged by >=2 tools are ~1.5x more likely to contain a real CVE than SIZE-MATCHED single-tool functions (1.54% vs 1.02%).
C01_1.5x.warrant: Size-matched multi- and single-tool functions differ only in tool count, so a rate difference is attributable to tool count.
C01_1.5x.estimand: P(vuln | n_tools>1) / P(vuln | n_tools=1), BINARY contrast
C01_1.5x.comparator: size-matched single-tool functions (not: all single-tool functions, which gives 2.67x)
C01_1.5x.bound: nine projects; project-bootstrap 95% CI [0.99x, 2.58x]; threshold not a score

defeater.condition: a size control coarser than the confound

adjustments.rationale: survived strata refinement 10->200 which could have refuted it

C02_fp_rk.asserts: An `fp:`-prefixed key can never equal an `rk:`-prefixed key.

C02_fp_rk.estimand: string equality over the key space
C02_fp_rk.bound: holds for this key construction only
